en: a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process
cn: 模型, 模范, 模特儿

examples.text: I'd like to try out this new model before I buy it.
He compared his car to the new model.
The high performance and the elegant design of this model have combined to give it a high reputation.

en: an assertion of a right (as to money or property)
cn: 要求, 要求权, 断言, 权利

examples.text: An insurance claim is a demand made by the insured for payment of the benefits as provided by the policy.
Do you have an objection to the source, or a relevant piece of evidence to refute the claim?
The claim that men evolved to hunt and women to gather is not supported by the evidence.

en: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior
cn: 星, 恒星, 星形物, 运气, 明星

examples.text: There was a big gold star on the door.
As an atom approaches the barycenter of a forming star, it trades potential for kinetic energy: the stuff of heat.
A planet is a large space body which reflects the light of a star around which it revolves.

en: a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
cn: 图画, 照片, 景色, 美丽如画的人(或物), 化身, 生动的描述, 想像, 形象思维

examples.text: I like this picture, not just because it's famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.
All you have to do is push this button to take a picture.
What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?

en: any standardized procedure for measuring sensitivity or memory or intelligence or aptitude or personality etc
cn: 测试, 试验, 化验, 检验, 考验, 甲壳

examples.text: If you pass this test, you could graduate next month.
I was the last one to turn in my test.
If he studied hard, he would pass the test.

en: a subdivision of a written work; usually numbered and titled
cn: 章, 篇, 重要章节

examples.text: At any rate, we have to finish this chapter before we can start on the next.
The author pins the crime on a character who pops up in the last chapter of this book.
If the first chapter is any indication, this book has the makings of a best seller.

en: a group of people who work together
cn: 组织, 结构, 团体, 体制

examples.text: In some cases, groups spreading misinformation create websites and social media accounts that look like a legitimate news organization.
His knowledge put him dangerously close to a secret the organization wouldn't let him live to hear.
In any great organization it is far, far safer to be wrong with the majority than to be right alone.

en: a document (or organization) from which information is obtained
cn: 来源, 水源, 根源, 原始资料, 源

examples.text: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
I can't locate the source of the problem.
A polite way to reveal knowledge of a fact without telling the source of the information is to say, "a little bird told me".

en: the act of bringing something to bear; using it for a particular purpose
cn: 应用, 申请, 志愿书, 应用程序

examples.text: You have to fill out an application for admission to the hospital at the front desk.
After she filled out the application, the records clerk told her that the fee was eight dollars.
This means you can reuse them freely for a textbook, for an application, for a research project, for anything!

en: a committee having supervisory powers
cn: 木板, 甲板, 膳食, 会议桌

examples.text: The names of the students who failed in the examination were posted on the bulletin board.
This further proof that the chairman of the board is a few croutons short of a salad.
The advisory board had a lot of qualms about her latest album, which she ended up releasing independently.

en: buildings for carrying on industrial labor
cn: 植物, 作物, 工厂, 树枝, 生长, 设施, 成套设备

examples.text: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.
The firefighters could not put out the fire at the industrial plant.
There's a new industrial plant in the north of the city.

en: something that is lost
cn: 损失, 遗失, 失败, 输, 错过, 伤亡

examples.text: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.
On the one hand we suffered a heavy loss, but on the other hand we learned a great deal from the experience.

en: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
cn: 运动, 游戏, 娱乐, 消遣, 玩笑

examples.text: The point we must clarify here is that the lines between amateur and professional in sport are beginning to disappear.
He does not care for any sport involving team work or quick responses to other players.
It is not wrong to say that chess is a sport: it is recognized as such.

en: the upper part of anything
cn: 顶部, 顶端, 极点, 上面, 上部, 顶篷, 最高地位, 首位, 陀螺

examples.text: Don't put anything on top of the box.
She lost her way and on top of that it began to rain.
The top of the mountain is covered in snow.

en: the concentration of attention or energy on something
cn: 焦点, 焦距

examples.text: Instead of focusing on the things that divide us, let's focus on the things that unite us.
Rather than focus on actual problems, they bicker among themselves, accusing each other of having beliefs that are insufficiently ideologically pure.
Instead of focusing on the ways that we're different, let's focus on the ways that we're similar.

en: the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
cn: 大小, 尺寸, 规模, 尺码, 能力, 浆料

examples.text: We have your size, but not in that color.
Do you have these shoes in my size?
I'm looking for a coat in my size.

en: the particular auditory effect produced by a given cause
cn: 声音, 语音, 吵闹, 声调, 听力范围, 探条, 海峡

examples.text: I just felt like hearing the sound of your voice.
A strange sound was heard from behind the door.
That's the most beautiful sound in the world.

en: something that interests you because it is important or affects you
cn: 关心, 忧虑

examples.text: The loss of childhood spontaneity has caused widespread concern, as well as calls for review of the nation's educational and social structures.
For a pillow like this all men do yearn but that - quite frankly - is not my concern.
It's a matter of great concern that two people on the plane that crashed were travelling on stolen passports.

en: nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
cn: 文章, 冠词, 物品, 物件, 条款, 契约

examples.text: That's the computer he used to write the article.
The news article painted the defendant as a guilty man, even though he had been proven innocent.
Given all the books you've written, would it really be so hard to write a small article?

en: a prominent attribute or aspect of something
cn: 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写

examples.text: The truly remarkable feature of sound production by birds is that the two sides of the syrinx can act independently.
The photo editor includes a feature which allows users to add a blur effect to images.
The coccyx is a vestigial feature that shows the common ancestry of mankind and apes.

en: any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
cn: 机器, 机械装置, 机构, 自动售货机, 机械般工作的人

examples.text: The engineer told us how to use the machine.
I think this machine is in need of repair.
Tell me how to use the washing machine.

en: (biology) the process of an individual organism growing organically; a purely biological unfolding of events involved in an organism changing gradually from a simple to a more complex level
cn: 生长, 栽培, 增长

examples.text: The rapid growth of the country has a lot to do with the characteristics of the people.
In such cases, adults should not scold them instantly, but be patient with them, considering their mental growth.
Up to this point I have presented an overview of the growth of political unrest in the period.

en: (mathematics) a mathematical relation such that each element of a given set is associated with an element of another set
cn: 官能, 职务, 功能, 函数

examples.text: The opacity of the lens is a function of the glass from which it was made.
A common function of a transducer is to convert a non-electrical physical quantity, like pressure, into a measurable electrical signal.
The greatest shortcoming of the human race is our inability to understand the exponential function.

en: involving the body as distinguished from the mind or spirit
cn: 身体的, 物质的, 自然的, 物理学的, 好色的

examples.text: The transfer of an astral body from one physical body to another became a tool for espionage.
We must stop urban sprawl and fight against physical segregation while still guaranteeing the right to housing.
Maybe in another universe, the physical laws are so different that everything from our point of view looks unfamiliar.

en: a statute in draft before it becomes law
cn: 帐单, 清单, 钞票, 鸟嘴, 广告, 法案, 票据

examples.text: In a bicameral legislature, both chambers must approve a bill before it becomes law.
The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.

en: a heading that names a statute or legislative bill; may give a brief summary of the matters it deals with
cn: 头衔, 名称, 标题, 书名, 扉页, 权利, 资格, 冠军, 字幕

examples.text: What is the title of your new book?
It depends on the person, but using "sir" for women (a title of honour for men) is very rude.
In the Internet age, the once noble title of publisher has been demoted to the insipid "content provider".

en: an interconnected system of things or people
cn: 网络, 广播网, 网状物

examples.text: The term neural net was traditionally used to name a network or circuit of biological neurons.
The physical world is a complex network of events, and nothing occurs for only one reason.
In the test set, the neural network correctly identified true planets and false positives 96 percent of the time.

en: any maneuver made as part of progress toward a goal
cn: 尺寸, 量度器, 量度标准, 测量, 量具, 程度, 范围, 限度, 分寸, 措施, 方法

examples.text: The use of a condom during vaginal, anal, and oral intercourse is the best preventive measure.
Thus the very points in which they differed seemed, in some measure, to ensure the continuance of their mutual affection.
And the waters prevailed beyond measure upon the earth: and all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.

en: a fee for services rendered based on a percentage of an amount received or collected or agreed to be paid (as distinguished from a salary)
cn: 委任状, 任官令, 所委职责, 佣金, 犯, 委托, 所托之事

examples.text: He has received a commission as a naval officer.
For the conveyance of a holiday home, the estate agent gets a commission of 8% of the cost of rent.
The parliament and parliamentary commission may require a member of the government to participate in the meeting.

en: the season of growth
cn: 春天, 弹簧, 跳跃, 弹性, 活力, 泉, 源泉

examples.text: Which do you like better, spring or autumn?
There was shade for the summer, flowers for the spring, fruits for the autumn, and indeed enjoyment for every season of the year.
The breeding season for wolves is usually in the late winter or early spring.

en: of or relating to the arts and manners that a group favors
cn: 文化的, 教养的, 修养的

examples.text: The amount of paper produced by a country is closely related to its cultural standards.
The first question we must raise is whether a cultural barrier existed between those groups.
Every citizen has the right to health and to a life that meets the minimum cultural standards.

en: a means or instrumentality for storing or communicating information
cn: 媒体, 方法, 媒介

examples.text: The medium allowed the spirit to take control of her body.
I like my steak medium, not rare or well-done.
I would class my garden as medium in size.

en: a journey for some purpose (usually including the return)
cn: 旅行, 绊倒, 摔倒, 失足, 差错, 旅程

examples.text: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.
I had a hard time trying to persuade him to cancel the trip.

en: the outer boundary of an artifact or a material layer constituting or resembling such a boundary
cn: 面, 表面, 水面, 外表, 平面

examples.text: There are so many fine scratches and dents on its surface that it's no use polishing it.
He thought he perceived the black fin of a shark swimming near the surface of the water.
As wind blows across the surface of the ocean or a lake, the continual disturbance creates a wave crest.

en: a source of difficulty
cn: 烦恼, 麻烦, 困难, 动乱, 故障

examples.text: I had no idea it would put you to so much trouble.
I got fired from the company, but since I have a little money saved up, for the time being, I won't have trouble with living expenses.
His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.

en: miscellaneous unspecified objects
cn: 原料, 要素, 东西, 材料, 素质, 织品, 废物, 废话

examples.text: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
I'm going to get rid of all this stuff.
This stuff is worth its weight in gold!

en: the most direct or specific meaning of a word or expression; the class of objects that an expression refers to
cn: 参考, 索引, 参照

examples.text: This is a direct reference to the writer's early works.
A tide gauge measures changes in sea level relative to a datum (a height reference).
We understand our own movements extremely well, and we can use them for reference.

en: (computer science) the code that identifies where a piece of information is stored
cn: 住址, 演说, 举止, 灵巧, 求爱

examples.text: All you have to do is to write your name and address here.
He said that if he knew her address, he would write to her.
May I ask you for your name and address?

en: a unit of length equal to 3 feet; defined as 91.44 centimeters; originally taken to be the average length of a stride
cn: 码, 庭院, 工场

examples.text: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.
I planted a peach tree in my yard.
I always have to check my yard for stagnant pools of water so mosquitoes don't breed there.

en: a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances
cn: 解决, 解答, 溶液

examples.text: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
I was young and I thought that joining the army was the solution to any problem.
Seems like every problem we manage to solve requires a greater genius to correct the damage the solution had caused.

en: a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty
cn: 意见, 评价, 主张

examples.text: If two men always have the same opinion, one of them is unnecessary.
In her opinion, he is the best musician she has ever seen.
In my opinion, it would be difficult to solve this problem.

en: chemical process in which one atom or ion or group changes places with another
cn: 交换, (电话)交换局, 交换机, 汇兑, 交易所

examples.text: A girl gave me an orange in exchange for a piece of cake.
The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.
The prosecutor agreed not to press charges in exchange for a hundred hours of community service.

en: be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.
cn: 参加, 照料, 伴随

examples.text: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
He called in to say he could not attend the meeting.
It is not necessary for us to attend the meeting.

en: marked by a tendency to find and call attention to errors and flaws
cn: 批评的, 决定性的, 危险的, 临界的

examples.text: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
She made a graceless exit from the meeting after realizing her presentation had critical errors.
The nurse told us not to enter the room because the patient was in a critical condition.

en: a particular instance of selling
cn: 出售, 卖, 拍卖, 销售额, 廉价出售

examples.text: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
This morning, I went to a fish selling counter and the flying fish was very fresh and also on sale.
I went to a sale with my mother yesterday and kept hounding her to buy me a dress.

en: instrumentalists not including string players
cn: 带子, 队, 乐队

examples.text: When we started out, our band could only find small clubs in small cities that would hire us.
It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
A brass band is marching along the street.

en: a set of related records (either written or electronic) kept together
cn: 档案, 公文箱, 文件夹, 文件, 卷宗, 锉刀

examples.text: Do you know how to recover a deleted file?
In which folder did you save the file?
When I try to listen to music with media player there's an error and I can't play the file.

en: close interaction
cn: 联系, 交际, 熟人, 接触

examples.text: We were unable to make contact with them until it was too late.
Do you keep in contact with your high school classmates?
By burying their dung balls, dung beetles bring dung into close contact with plant roots.

en: an implement consisting of a length of wood
cn: 棍, 棒, 刺, 枯枝, 茎, 条状物

examples.text: When the school had no books or paper or pencils, she wrote the alphabet on the ground with a stick.
The general, without interrupting his speech, hit him on the head with his heavy ivory stick; the barbarian fell.
I dreamt that, using nothing but a stick, you saved me from a giant squid monster.

en: a short section or illustration (as between radio or tv programs or in a magazine) that is often used for advertising
cn: 污点, 地点, 斑点, 点, 娱乐场所, 处境, 少量

examples.text: If you wish to forget anything on the spot, make a note that this thing is to be remembered.
It is not to be wondered at, for time hangs heavily in this lonely spot to an active man like him.
I must and will hear the truth from her own mouth; without this satisfaction I will not leave this spot.

en: the activity of exerting your muscles in various ways to keep fit
cn: 行使, 执行, 运动, 练习, 作业

examples.text: All collectors of out of the way books know the pleasure of the exercise of serendipity, but they enjoy it in different ways.
I am in the habit of taking some exercise before breakfast.
I suggest that you do more exercise to keep your blood pressure down.

en: a list of names
cn: 卷, 滚动, 名单, 案卷, 压路机

examples.text: The pilot controls the roll of the plane by raising one aileron or the other with a control wheel.
In helicopters, the cyclic controls the tilt of the main rotor, producing pitch and roll.
The roll of toilet paper hit the ground and began rolling, unraveling along the way.

en: an intuitive assumption
cn: 结论, 结尾, 推论

examples.text: We are interested in the flow of evacuation events from the occurrence of a large earthquake to the conclusion of emergency countermeasures.
We humans have a great way of twisting facts to fit our conclusion as soon as we have made one.
In conclusion, the next step is to decide what we should do for the next step.

en: an instance of visual perception
cn: 景观, 视力, 眼界, 阅读, 见解, 意见

examples.text: The baby caught sight of my ballpoint pen and reached out for it.
The traveler was delighted at the sight of a light in the distance.
She waved her hand until the train was out of sight.

en: contribute to the progress or growth of
cn: 促进, 晋升, 创办, 推销

examples.text: Instead of engaging in passive-aggressive behavior towards me, explore activities that promote personal growth and a more harmonious environment.
The city council discussed plans to implement a bike lane to alleviate traffic and promote alternative transportation.
When each side has only the king and some pawns, you need to calculate moves carefully to promote a pawn before your opponent.

en: the act of giving temporary assistance
cn: 举起, 帮助, 昂扬, 电梯

examples.text: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.
One of his flatmates often gives him a lift when he's late.
I was wondering if you could give me a lift, if it isn't too much trouble.

en: a person's social heritage: previous experience or training
cn: 背景, 背景资料

examples.text: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
Pay will be based on experience and educational background.
With this as background I turn now to an account of the present state of evolutionary biology.

en: the act of beginning something new
cn: 介绍, 传入, 采用, 初步

examples.text: You should read the introduction at the beginning of the book.
Here I want to bring the introduction to a close and get to the real subject.
The life of some dairy farmers has gotten a lot easier since the introduction of robots to milk the cows.

en: the feeling that comes when something burdensome is removed or reduced
cn: 减轻, 解除, 救济, 安慰, 调剂, 浮雕, 换班, (地势的)起伏

examples.text: He felt a sense of relief when he saw that she was alive.
She heaved a sigh of relief when she heard the good news.
She gave a sigh of relief when the work was done.

en: one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)
cn: 波, 波浪, 波动, 起伏, 高潮, 潮涌, 挥手致意, (气压)突变

examples.text: A seiche is a standing wave oscillating in a body of water.
A catamaran is unlikely to be capsized by wind, but a big enough rogue wave can do it.
The young man wrapped himself up in a down quilt and dreamed of a heat wave.

en: the act of constructing something
cn: 建筑, 构造, 建筑物

examples.text: We're sorry that the pace of construction is not sufficient to address the great demand for apartments.
The construction of the dam will undoubtedly have the resulting effect of forcing thousands of families to relocate elsewhere.
The construction of the dam will have serious environmental consequences for the local fauna and flora.

en: a relative position or degree of value in a graded group
cn: 等级, 年级, 阶段, 成绩, 程度, 坡度, 斜坡

examples.text: I was in fourth grade when I gave a girl a real kiss and spoke to her about our common future.
We all try hard to make the grade in life, but only a few succeed.
After fifth grade in primary school I would spend my summer vacations as their apprentice.

en: outward or visible aspect of a person or thing
cn: 出现, 露面, 外观, 外表, 出版

examples.text: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
The aim of art is to represent not the outward appearance of things, but their inward significance.
Yet, with all this strange appearance of humility, and this contempt for human reason, he ventures into the boldest presumptions.

en: the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared
cn: 差别, 对比, 对照物

examples.text: There is something tropical and exotic about her which forms a singular contrast to her cool and unemotional brother.
There was a strange contrast between the sweet promise of the spring and this sinister quest upon which we were engaged.
Her rich tints made the white face of her companion the more worn and haggard by the contrast.

en: involving the mind or an intellectual process
cn: 心智的, 精神病的, 心理的, 颏的

examples.text: Our best pictures of the human mind suggest that we don't plop our mental activities into single, ordered boxes.
In such cases, adults should not scold them instantly, but be patient with them, considering their mental growth.
It is impossible to calculate the moral mischief, if I may so express it, that mental lying has produced in society.

en: enter upon an activity or enterprise
cn: 试图, 从事, 保证, 承担, 同意, 接受

examples.text: So fine was the thread that no frame could be found to weave it upon, nor would any weaver undertake to make one.
When, one day, computers undertake to translate literary works, it will be the end of literature as we know it.
On a case-by-case basis, in accordance with legislation, the environmental assessment branch will consider requests from members of the general public to undertake an environmental review.

en: a fundamental feeling that is hard to define but that people desire to experience
cn: 快乐, 愉快, 令人高兴的事, 娱乐, 希望

examples.text: It has always been a pleasure to work with you.
It's a pleasure to have you with us again.
I don't like to mix business with pleasure.

en: a small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles
cn: 口袋, 钱袋, 钱, 容器

examples.text: The boy has an apple in his pocket.
This hamster is small enough to carry in your pocket.
He felt in his pocket for his wallet.

en: an event in which something is displaced without rotation
cn: 变化, 移动, 轮班, 手段, 应急办法, 移位

examples.text: I picked up a last-minute shift because someone at work got sick and went home early.
When you work the night shift, you can end up feeling isolated from your friends.
It may take a few weeks to get used to working the night shift.

en: something intended to communicate a particular impression
cn: 显示, 陈列, 炫耀, 显示器

examples.text: The scrolling text on the display of my Internet radio gives me information about the selected station and the running program.
The patient stepped onto the scale and waited for the digital display to show their weight.
In his weekly column in the local newspaper, the art critic praised the paintings and sculptures on display at the exhibition center.

en: providing or experiencing physical well-being or relief (`comfy' is informal)
cn: 舒服的, 轻松的

examples.text: This chair is really comfortable to sit on.
The waiting room was kept at a pleasant temperature, and the seats provided were exceptionally comfortable.
Every man has a right to life; and this means that he has also a right to make a comfortable living.

en: the act of forcibly dispossessing an owner of property
cn: 抓取, 战利品, 捕获之物

examples.text: The capture of baby elephants is horribly cruel and traumatic to both the mothers, their calves and the herds that are left behind.
The checker and the king can both forward and backward capture one or more pieces.
The checker that, when performing the capture of several pieces, passes through a coronation square, without stopping there, will not be promoted to a king.

en: recognize with gratitude; be grateful for
cn: 赏识, 鉴别, 为...而感激, 领会, 欣赏

examples.text: I appreciate it when a native speaker tries to help me sound more like a native speaker.
We very often only come to appreciate someone or our relationship with them when we lose them.
I'd appreciate it if you could come early and help me get ready for the party.

en: an instance of change; the rate or magnitude of change
cn: 变更, 变化, 变种, 变奏

examples.text: A turbofan engine is the most modern variation of the basic gas turbine engine.
The definition you gave fails to encompass some of the variation we see.
The latest variation of the classic tinfoil hat is the tinfoil beret.

en: a minor inadvertent mistake usually observed in speech or writing or in small accidents or memory lapses etc.
cn: 滑, 滑行, 事故, 溜, 差错, 滑台, 下降, 插条, 后裔, 板条, 瘦长的年轻人

examples.text: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
He knows that his critics are waiting to pounce on any slip that he makes.
I was trying to follow her, but she gave me the slip.

en: an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth
cn: 估计, 判断

examples.text: My estimate of the cost of the damage was off by more than two million dollars.
At a rough estimate, I would say the job will take two weeks.
According to an estimate, steel production will reach 100 million tons this year.

en: someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies

en: the act of making and recording a measurement
cn: 观察, 注意, 观测, 观察力

cn: 块, 大多数, 质量, 大量, 群众, 弥撒

en: properties attributable to your ancestry

en: a large and unbroken expanse or distance

cn: 大会, 协定, 惯例, 约定

en: a prescribed selection of foods

en: the violent interaction of individuals or groups entering into combat

examples.text: The news that her son was injured in the accident was a great shock to her.

en: a telegram sent abroad

en: the actors in a play
cn: 演员阵容, 投掷, 铸件, 预测, 特性

It's just so frustrating to try to do this with my arm in a cast.

en: (geology) a crack in the earth's crust resulting from the displacement of one side with respect to the other

en: a mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity
cn: 不景气, 消沉, 沮丧, 洼地

en: bar from attention or consideration

en: a mutually agreed delay in the date set for the completion of a job or payment of a debt

en: acting with or marked by or resulting from great force or energy or emotional intensity

en: the extent downward or backward or inward
cn: 深度, 深处, 深奥

en: a place (seaport or airport) where people and merchandise can enter or leave a country
cn: 港口, 埠, 舱门, 避风港, 左舷, 炮眼, 姿势, 意义

examples.text: When the storm was over, we began to make preparations to leave the port.

en: the act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)
cn: 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡

en: a small flat rectangular piece of glass on which specimens can be mounted for microscopic study
cn: 滑, 滑道, 山崩, 雪崩, 幻灯片

In our park, we have a nice slide for children to play on.

en: the state of being obligated to do or pay something
cn: 义务, 责任, 约束, 契约, 恩惠, 债务

en: an interval during which a recurring sequence of events occurs
cn: 周期, 循环, 自行车, 一段时间, 整套

en: the body of people in a learned occupation
cn: 职业, 表白, 声明
